headline: Côte d'Ivoire: Saint Joseph Innoplaza Center, a mixed-use complex worth 13 billion FCFA to reshape the urban landscape of Plateau
summary: A 13 billion FCFA mixed-use complex in Abidjan's Plateau district has been formalised through a 40-year emphyteutic lease signed by the Archdiocese of Abidjan and SCI Innoplaza Center.
why: Large private property developments in Abidjan's business district reflect investment flows into West Africa's largest urban real estate market.
original_headline: Côte d’Ivoire: le Saint Joseph Innoplaza Center, un complexe mixte de 13 milliards de FCFA pour redessiner le paysage urbain du Plateau
